verdict.rationale: User-defined event-triggered rules are a fair question for a SaaS tax platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only built-in behaviors and API endpoints, not a capability for users to define their own rules. Built-in nexus alerts ('Early alerts before you owe anywhere'), automated filing, and the Stripe integration are vendor-defined automations, and the APIs are building blocks; neither counts as a user rule engine or event-action trigger.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
